title: Portals?
content: I’m not sure if this is just a me thing, but has anyone else experienced traveling through portals in a dream? Usually, after I go through the portal, the dream becomes something else entirely. It becomes not just your average dream, but more real and meaningful. I’ve just discovered this sub, and it’s amazing to be able to talk about this stuff!! Most people completely dismiss me when I try to talk about dreams, and I feel silly for talking about it. But I personally believe there are two types of dreams. There are dreams that are just our subconscious resetting our minds and making sense of the previous day. But then there are dreams that are actual astral travel, where you can interact with people and places that exist. And maybe there’s a 3rd category as well, which are dreams that are symbolic messages or prophecies.
